Language hero, journo Zainul laid to rest
2017-03-11T00:00:00+06:00 | Bss, Dhaka
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/language-veteran-journo-zainul-abedin-laid-rest-1374052

Zainul Abedin, a senior journalist and one of the 1952 Language Movement veterans, was buried at the Martyred Intellectuals' Graveyard yesterday.

The 81-year-old, who died at Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University on Thursday night, was laid to rest around 3:30pm following his second namaj-e-janaza at Baitul Mukarram National Mosque after the Juma prayers. Earlier, his first namaj-e-janaza was held at Jatiya Press Club at 9:00am.

Senior journalists including Jatiya Press Club President Muhammad Shafiqur Rahman, former president Khondoker Monirul Alam, senior vice president Saiful Alam; president of a faction of BFUJ Monjurul Ahsan Bulbul and secretary general Omar Faruque; president of a faction of DUJ Saban Mahmud and general secretary Sohel Haider Chowdhury, among others, participated in the janaza.

Diplomatic Correspondents Association, Bangladesh (DCAB) also expressed deep shock at Zainul's demise in a condolence message, signed by DCAB President Rezaul Karim Lotus and General Secretary Pantho Rahman.
